notes: CrawlHiveToken (src/CrawlHiveToken.sol) is a plain, fixed-supply OpenZeppelin 5.4.0 ERC-20 named CrawlHive with symbol CRAWLHIVE and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 CRAWLHIVE (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the ProjectFactory; the factory then pays all of it out. Every transfer moves exactly the amount requested: there is no fee, tax, burn-on-transfer, reflection, max-wallet or cooldown, so the token needs no factory, pool manager or distributor exemptions and takes none of the launch placeholders. There is no owner, no mint after deployment, no pause, blocklist, freeze, seize, burnFrom or upgrade, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. No application contracts are deployed with this launch and no initialization calls are needed. The pool pairs against IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 with fee 12500 and tick spacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
